dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking! To put it simply, I'm responsible for liaison work between the Communications Office's Hezhe Post and the Millelith, the teahouses, the Secure Transport Agency, and other organizations.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: If the leader of a group of guards for hire has guards waiting to be dispatched, I'll go get an order from Hezhe Post.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: If the teahouse sends someone here to confirm a tea delivery order on its behalf, I'll direct them to talk to the appropriate harbor staff to discuss the details.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: If a merchant wants make a large shipment to a foreign port and needs to have his goods inspected and registered first, I'll connect them to a specialist at Hezhe Post...
